verdict.rationale: Gusto publishes a documented public Embedded Payroll API. Evidence includes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec (versioned v2026-06-15), an llms.txt index of every API reference page, and concrete endpoint docs such as the general ledger report flow. An MCP server, a CLI and webhooks are built around the same API. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API, evidence that the API covers the core Gusto product rather than only the Embedded Payroll partner surface, and documented access/authentication terms for end users.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: lists every guide and API reference page as markdown links
interact directly with the Embedded Payroll API and relevant documentation
